label_descriptions.first-page: offset=0, limit smaller than total returns the first slice. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising the first-page case.
label_descriptions.middle-page: offset>0 and offset+limit<total returns a middle slice. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising a middle-page case.
label_descriptions.last-page-partial: offset+limit exceeds total but offset<total — returns the remaining items, which is fewer than limit. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising the partial-last-page case.
label_descriptions.offset-past-end: offset>=total returns empty items array with hasMore false. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising offset-past-end.
label_descriptions.empty-input: Input array is empty. Returns empty items, hasMore false. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising empty input.
label_descriptions.zero-limit: limit<=0 returns empty items array. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising zero-or-negative limit.
label_descriptions.negative-offset: offset<0 is treated as zero. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising negative offset.
label_descriptions.has-more-flag: hasMore is true when there are items beyond the slice, false otherwise. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion checking the hasMore flag in both states.
